name: The Haven
status: The economic and professional center of dungeon exploration
careerMeaning: Returning from the Haven with a profitable cargo is a career-defining achievement. Most successful expeditions build their reputations here rather than attempting the deep frontier.
economyLoop: Surface sponsors finance entry, transport, insurance, and replacement equipment.
Expeditions carry labor, tools, brewing stock, trade goods, and contracts inward.
The Haven converts recovered materials and information into portable value.
Caravans move artifacts, crafted gear, substances, records, and rescued or captive persons toward the surface.
Assay houses, banks, guilds, and governments divide the proceeds through taxes, liens, shares, and seizure claims.

districts.name: Gateward Caravan Yards
districts.function: Porters, pack animals, carts, storage, route contracts, repair crews, and outbound convoy formation.

districts.name: Seal Exchange
districts.function: Artifact appraisal, provenance disputes, auctions, expedition shares, insurance, and sovereign claims.

districts.name: Iron Ledger Houses
districts.function: Banking, reminting, coin assays, shaved-coin detection, debt instruments, and goblin-founded exchange practices.

districts.name: Makers' Quarter
districts.function: Crafting guilds, monster-part preservation, commissions, salvage breakdown, and equipment retirement.

districts.name: Chain Market
districts.function: The legal and illegal trade in enslaved people, penal labor, debt bondage, dungeon captives, ransom claims, and liberation contracts. It is a major source of political conflict and organized crime.

districts.name: Low Lantern Ward
districts.function: Inns, consensual adult sex work, pleasure houses, information brokerage, blackmail, patronage, and anti-trafficking investigations.

districts.name: Draughtworks
districts.function: Breweries, medicinal spirits, magical intoxicants, dependence treatment, contraband laboratories, and customs inspection.

districts.name: Underways
districts.function: Smuggling routes, sewer predators, hidden shrines, counterfeit Gate seals, and cargo laundering.

expeditionStanding.meaning: Historical figure; the known expedition failed here
